sourceIssues.description: BOYKOVDOCS_SEO_SECTIONS_TAGS.txt is named in specification §23 but is absent from the supplied ZIP. The workbook includes dictionary rows for all 2 catalogs, 52 sections and 79 tags.
W21–W28 have no value in source column J (SEO H1 / целевой кластер). Empty values are retained.
W21–W28 have blank source column N; initial noindex is explicitly required by the technical specification §5.2 and BOYKOVDOCS_RECLASSIFICATION_RULES.txt.
Workbook cell P5 says Без назначенного раздела, with S5=63. All 2169 CSV rows have a section. Exactly 63 rows require manual review; these counts must not be interpreted as missing section IDs.
